quotes.text: In power bi terms, the hub holds your certified semantic models, shared data sets, and standardized measures the official truth. The spokes are your departmental workspaces.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Defines the hub-and-spoke split for Power BI in two clear sentences.

quotes.text: Every shared data set must have two parents, a business owner and a technical one. The business owner decides what the measure means, what qualifies as active customer or gross margin.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Gives a concrete, actionable ownership rule for shared datasets.

quotes.text: Never add individuals manually. The moment you start assigning rights user by user, you've guaranteed drift and confusion. Groups are your armor against the chaos of turnover.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A crisp best-practice recommendation for workspace permissions.

quotes.text: Governance without version control is like driving without seat belts and insisting your reflexes are enough.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Memorable analogy for why versioning belongs in BI governance.

quotes.text: You can't buy your way out of Powerbi chaos. You have to plan your way out. The hub and spoke model isn't a configuration. It's a contract between sanity and speed.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sums up the episode's core thesis that planning, not tooling, prevents sprawl.

chapters.title: The Power BI wild west: duplication
The hub: ownership, certification and lineage
The spokes: thin reports and shared standards
Scaling with deployment pipelines and gateways

takeaways: Put certified semantic models in a governed hub and let departmental spoke workspaces build thin reports on top of them instead of duplicating data.
Give every shared dataset a named business owner and technical owner, and use certification, lineage and version control to make trust verifiable.
Assign workspace roles through Entra security groups and promote content through dev, test and production with deployment pipelines and clustered gateways.
hook: Forty versions of the same sales dashboard and nobody trusts the numbers? This episode is for Power BI admins, BI leads and analysts who want self-service without the sprawl. You'll learn how to plan a hub-and-spoke model with certified datasets, clear ownership, secure workspaces and deployment pipelines before your reports explode.
